recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-32496 unless the work group later decides to change the general Identifier uniqueness policy.
issue_request: FHIR-32496 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration change request for R5 asking to add PractitionerRole.identifier guidance that identifier values are not guaranteed unique across PractitionerRole instances and may repeat within one instance with different Identifier.period values.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit bc76ad2cb217b0aa676065d3dd4d42ac7ee1a19e, which added the requested comment to source/practitionerrole/structuredefinition-PractitionerRole.xml. Commit 086649a2357c29f8c83dca7604dc592d32c84355 later created the PractitionerRole/Participant mapping exception file and carried the same PractitionerRole.identifier comment there. Later PractitionerRole refactors preserved the guidance.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists practitionerrole=PractitionerRole, so source/practitionerrole/structuredefinition-PractitionerRole.xml is in current build scope. Current source has the requested guidance exactly on PractitionerRole.identifier and the mapping exception also reflects it. Patient Administration January 2022 WGM minutes record the issue discussion and 7-0-0 persuasive vote. A focused Zulip search for FHIR-32496 and the distinctive identifier phrase found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch and made no source edit because the current build-scoped PractitionerRole definition already contains the substantive guidance requested by the issue.
